# Reference: what ships

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-reference-docs.mjs from library/ and craft/; do not edit. -->

Everything here is read from the shipped files, so it is current. `beeps archetypes`, `beeps instruments` and `beeps capabilities` print the same data as JSON.

## Archetypes

`beeps generate <archetype>` samples one. The recipe is what it is built from; the family sets its loudness offset and tail ceiling.

| Archetype | Family | Recipe | Ranges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alarm` | alarm | One square oscillator that alternates between two fixed pitches at a fixed rate; only the pitch pair, rate and filter vary, never the pattern. | 9 |
| `blip` | blip | A single square or triangle oscillator of about 30 ms at speaking-voice pitch with a near-instant envelope; pitch, wave and filter vary. | 5 |
| `coin` | coin | One square oscillator that holds a note, then steps to a second in-scale pitch (pitchEnv step) with a short decay and a lowpass. | 6 |
| `coin-arp` | coin | A triangle arpeggio of three in-scale notes stepped by pitchEnv, over an additive shimmer layer an octave and more above. | 7 |
| `coin-bell` | coin | Two struck FM bell notes a small in-scale interval apart, with the second delayed slightly, through a short room reverb. | 7 |
| `confirm` | confirm | Two FM bell notes, the second an in-scale step above the first, each a short struck tone with no reverb. | 6 |
| `creature` | creature | A voice source with a gentle falling f0, vibrato and jitter through a set of formants; the family archetype the others specialise. | 10 |
| `creature-bleat` | creature | A voice source (glottal pulses through formants) with deep fast vibrato and tremolo for the wobble. | 10 |
| `creature-cluck` | creature | A voice source of about 90 ms whose f0 drops fast through mid formants. | 7 |
| `creature-growl` | creature | A voice source with heavy jitter and fast tremolo through low formants. | 11 |
| `creature-hiss` | creature | A voice source with breath noise only, through narrow high formants. | 7 |
| `creature-huff` | creature | A voice source that is mostly breath noise through loose formants, with a faint voiced core. | 8 |
| `creature-low` | creature | A voice source with a soft glottal slope and slow vibrato through deep rounded formants, about a second long. | 10 |
| `creature-yip` | creature | A voice source whose f0 snaps up and settles, through bright formants with a little jitter. | 9 |
| `explosion` | explosion | White noise blast closing into a brown-noise rumble, thinning debris grains and a low sine thump, through a room reverb. | 8 |
| `fanfare` | fanfare | Four staggered sawtooth notes (root, third, fifth, octave) through a lowpass that opens on each note, the last one held longest, over a small room reverb. | 9 |
| `hit` | hit | A short white-noise burst over a low modal body with a faint metal layer for the edge. | 7 |
| `jump` | jump | One square oscillator with a rising pitchEnv glide and a short decay. | 6 |
| `land` | land | A sine with a falling pitch drop (the thud) plus a brown-noise tick, lowpassed. | 6 |
| `laser` | laser | A square or saw oscillator with a fast exponential pitch drop through a closing lowpass. | 8 |
| `no` | no | Two triangle oscillators a falling minor third apart, soft attack, no buzz. | 6 |
| `notification` | notification | Two FM bell notes a fourth or fifth apart with a low modulation index, the second ringing longer, through a small room reverb and held a few dB under a confirm. | 7 |
| `pickup` | pickup | Two additive bell-like chimes, the second a fourth, fifth or octave above the first. | 6 |
| `powerdown` | powerdown | A triangle oscillator with a falling glide and a slow wobble from a pitch LFO. | 6 |
| `powerup` | powerup | Four square oscillators stepping root, third, fifth and octave in the project scale, each a short note. | 8 |
| `riser` | riser | A white-noise layer through a bandpass that sweeps from low to high while its level swells, over a sawtooth whose pitch climbs about an octave and a half, both ending in a short release. | 11 |
| `stinger` | stinger | A short lowpassed white-noise burst and a low modal body for the hit, with an FM bell a fifth above ringing out as the tail, through a small room reverb. | 8 |
| `transition` | transition | Two white-noise layers, a bandpass that sweeps upward over a swelling envelope and a faint highpass hiss, over a sine swell an octave or two below that fades with the noise. | 11 |
| `ui-click` | ui-click | A single modal tick of about 30 ms: a damped resonator excited by a short impulse. | 5 |
| `ui-hover` | ui-hover | A very short quiet sine or triangle touch with a soft attack. | 5 |
| `whoosh` | whoosh | Two white-noise layers: a bandpass whose centre sweeps upward over a swelling envelope, and a faint airy highpass hiss. | 7 |

## Sound collections

Authored patches under `library/sounds/`. Copy one into a project with `beeps sync` or read it as an example.

### colony-sfx (13)

| Patch | Family | Intent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effects/discovery.json` | confirm | A new find. Four soft glass notes unfold upward, with a low warm anchor. Reserve for first discoveries. |
| `effects/door.json` | foley | Interior door. A rounded latch and short air seal, ending in a cushioned closing catch; neither a heavy slam nor a UI beep. |
| `effects/harvest.json` | pickup | Picked with care. A plant stem releases with a woody pluck and two restrained sunlit overtones. A small harvest, not a jackpot. |
| `effects/plant.json` | foley | A seed tucked in. Seeds pour from a palm into soft soil and settle with a low, rounded wum; planting is confirmed without a reward chime. |
| `effects/portal.json` | transition | Across the threshold. A low field gathers, airy pressure passes and a crystalline fifth opens onto another place. One cue per completed travel. |
| `effects/repair.json` | confirm | The fitting catches. Two small hardware contacts and a restrained warm resonance mark a successful repair; only after materials are spent. |
| `effects/rest.json` | confirm | Breathe, then begin again. A warm descending ceramic pair over a soft exhale; a short rest transition, never a persistent hum. |
| `effects/till.json` | foley | Soil and steel. A padded cultivator bite, small metal handle knock and loose soil settling. Successful tilling only. |
| `effects/water.json` | foley | Watering the roots. A brief soft pour with staggered round droplets; useful for repeated watering without a piercing hiss. |

## Instruments

Patches songs play by name (`beeps instruments`). Root is the note the layers sound at as built; a written note far from it is retuned (lint `song-written-pitch`).

| Instrument | Root | Plays | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `acid-bass` | C3 | held (lasts the note length) | Resonant saw bass whose filter snaps shut on every note: rolling acid lines, octave 2 to 3. |
| `arp-blip` | C5 | one-shot (rings ~0.2 s) | Short square blip, chiptune-clean: fast arps and sequences. |
| `bell` | C5 | one-shot (rings ~3.6 s) | FM bell rooted at C5 with an inharmonic ratio: long ring, bright strike. Octave 5-6. |
| `bounce-bass` | C3 | held (lasts the note length) | Saw and sine bass that falls an octave in its first 80 ms: bouncy melodic-dubstep bass, octave 2 to 3. |
| `choir-pad` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Vowel-like aah pad: sawtooth through two formant peaks with a breath of pink noise. |
| `clap` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~0.2 s) | Two layers of bandpassed noise with a soft second burst: a hand clap. |
| `crash` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~2 s) | Highpassed white noise with a 1.6 s decay: a crash for section starts. |
| `deep-kick` | C3 | one-shot (rings ~0.6 s) | Sine kick falling from 130 to 40 Hz with a short click: a deep half-time or house kick. |
| `drone` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Dark evolving drone: low saw cluster with a sine body under a slowly sweeping filter. Hold one note per section: octave 2 when it is the only bass, octave 3 under a moving bass line. |
| `e-piano` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Tine electric piano (FM): warm bell-edged attack that mellows as it decays. Chords and gentle melodies, octave 3-4. |
| `felt-piano` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Felted upright piano: soft hammer thump, rounded partials that decay on their own clocks. Intimate melodies and chords, octave 3-5. |
| `glass-bell` | C5 | one-shot (rings ~4 s) | Additive glass/celesta: clean partials that each decay on their own clock. |
| `glass-pad` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Wide detuned saw pad with a slowly breathing lowpass and an airy octave; slow swell. Chords. |
| `glitch` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~0.1 s) | Seventy 6 ms grains a second around 3.2 kHz: glitch bursts. Use `?` steps so they scatter. |
| `growl` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Three-operator FM bass through a driven, wobbling lowpass: brostep growl (lfo.sync 3 follows the song tempo in triplet eighths; override /layers/0/lfo/sync). Heard alone it wobbles at 3.5 Hz. Octave 1 to 2. |
| `hand-drum` | G3 | one-shot (rings ~0.5 s) | Hand drum (djembe/tabla-like membrane, modal): a pitched slap with a skin rustle. Steps with `note` tune it (G3 open tone, C4-D4 higher slaps); vary x/o accents for a played feel. |
| `hat` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~0.1 s) | Closed hat: 808 metal voice through a highpass, very short. |
| `hoover` | G4 | held (lasts the note length) | Five-voice saw that glides down a fifth into each note: rave hooks and stab leads, octave 4. |
| `kick` | D3 | one-shot (rings ~0.4 s) | Soft round kick: sine with a fast pitch drop and a tiny click. |
| `mallet` | C4 | one-shot (rings ~0.9 s) | Marimba-like struck bar (modal): woody, short, warm. |
| `nebula` | unpitched | held (lasts the note length) | Filtered pink-noise wind with a slowly drifting band: space air under a section. |
| `open-hat` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~0.4 s) | 808 metal voice highpassed, ringing 280 ms: an open hi-hat for offbeats. |
| `pluck` | C4 | one-shot (rings ~0.6 s) | Bright saw pluck whose filter snaps shut: arps and ostinatos. |
| `prog-pad` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Five-voice saw pad with a slowly breathing lowpass and a long swell: wide, moving chords, octave 3. |
| `prog-pluck` | C4 | one-shot (rings ~0.3 s) | Square and saw pluck whose filter snaps shut: progressive-house arpeggios and short hooks, octave 4 to 5. |
| `pulse-bass` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Analog-style saw bass with a plucky filter envelope; set track keytrack ~0.5. |
| `punch-kick` | F3 | one-shot (rings ~0.4 s) | Sine kick falling from 170 to 46 Hz with a bright click: a punchy four-on-the-floor kick. |
| `rave-stab` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Six-voice saw and square stab with a closing filter: offbeat chord hits, octave 3 to 4. |
| `reese` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Three detuned saws and a sine under a slowly moving lowpass: the drum-and-bass and dubstep reese. Hold notes; octave 1 to 2. |
| `rim` | Ab6 | one-shot (rings ~0.1 s) | Woody rim click (modal): quiet ticking percussion. |
| `riser` | unpitched | held (lasts the note length) | Stereo noise through a bandpass sweeping from 400 Hz up to 9 kHz over seven seconds: a build. Hold one note for the length of the build and fade it in with a section mix ramp. |
| `screech` | C5 | held (lasts the note length) | FM tone with a pitch bend up, drive and a highpass: dubstep screeches and sirens, octave 5 to 6. Short notes with rests. |
| `shaker` | unpitched | one-shot (rings ~0.1 s) | Soft grainy shaker: a short burst of Poisson grains. |
| `shimmer` | C6 | one-shot (rings ~2.8 s) | High glassy sparkle: sine partials at the note, an octave and an octave-plus-fifth above; written pitch is where it sounds (use octave 6). Sparse high notes. |
| `snare-dnb` | C4 | one-shot (rings ~0.2 s) | Tight triangle body and highpassed noise: a crisp snare for fast tempos. |
| `snare-dub` | G3 | one-shot (rings ~0.3 s) | Triangle body and bandpassed, driven noise: a heavy half-time snare. |
| `snare` | F#3 | one-shot (rings ~0.3 s) | Soft electronic snare: tone body plus bandpassed noise. |
| `soft-lead` | C5 | held (lasts the note length) | Mellow triangle/square lead with light vibrato: understated melodies. |
| `soft-pluck` | C4 | one-shot (rings ~1 s) | Rounded triangle pluck, harp-like: gentle arps. |
| `sonar` | C5 | one-shot (rings ~2.8 s) | Sonar ping: pure sine rooted at C5, slow decay. Space it far apart; pair with a delay send. |
| `string-pad` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Ensemble strings: many detuned saws, soft attack, gentle vibrato. Chords and long melody notes. |
| `sub-bass` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Round sine sub with a little triangle for small speakers. |
| `sub-boom` | A1 | one-shot (rings ~1.4 s) | A 55 Hz sine boom sinking to 34 Hz over a brown-noise thump: an impact for the start of a drop. Write one long note. |
| `supersaw` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Seven-voice detuned saw plus an airy octave above: trance and house chords and big leads. Held for the note length; octave 3 to 4. |
| `synth-brass` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Saw brass that swells open: horn calls and big chords. |
| `theremin` | C5 | held (lasts the note length) | Sine lead with slow vibrato and a soft onset: the classic sci-fi voice. |
| `tom` | A2 | one-shot (rings ~0.6 s) | Deep tom: a fixed-pitch sine (about 110 Hz falling to 70 Hz) for fills and hand-drum pulses. Use in steps patterns without a note; a note transposes it. |
| `trance-lead` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Five-voice saw lead over a square body an octave down, its filter closing as it sounds: gated riffs and sixteenth-note leads, octave 4 to 5. |
| `vox-ah` | C3 | held (lasts the note length) | Chopped vowel "ah": a formant voice for syncopated vocal stabs and chants. Written pitch is the note; octave 3 to 5. The formants do not move with pitch. |
| `vox-ee` | C3 | held (lasts the note length) | Chopped vowel "ee": a bright, thin formant voice for high stabs. Octave 3 to 5. |
| `vox-oo` | C3 | held (lasts the note length) | Chopped vowel "oo": a rounder, darker formant voice for chops and pads of voices. Octave 3 to 5. |
| `warm-pad` | C4 | held (lasts the note length) | Soft triangle-and-sine pad, no edge, slow attack: sits under everything. Sounds at the written octave. |
| `wobble` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Detuned saw bass with a resonant lowpass wobbling in time with the song (lfo.sync 2: eighth notes; change it with a { base, set } override of /layers/0/lfo/sync, 1 for quarters, 3 for triplets). Heard alone it wobbles at 3.5 Hz. Octave 1 to 2. |
| `wonk-bass` | C2 | held (lasts the note length) | Resonant saw bass whose filter opens on each note, with a slow pitch wobble: wonky half-time bass, octave 1 to 2. |

## Craft rules

Every rule cites its sources in `craft/rules.json` and `craft/music-rules.json`. `auto` rules are checked by `beeps lint` and `beeps song lint`; `judgement` rules are listed for the author to weigh.

### Sound rules

| Rule | Severity | Check | Applies to | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `true-peak-ceiling` | error | auto | patch | The delivered sound's true peak (4x oversampled) is at or below -1 dBTP. |
| `no-clipping` | error | auto | patch | The delivered sound has no clipped samples. |
| `no-dc` | error | auto | patch | The authored sound has no DC offset: the absolute mean sample value is below 0.001. |
| `attack-floor` | error | auto | patch | Every layer's declared attack is at least 4 ms, and the measured attack (10 to 90 % of the envelope peak) is at least 2 ms, unless meta.intent is 'click'. Quiet transient layers at gainDb -9 or below may be faster. |
| `nyquist` | error | auto | patch | No declared frequency (source pitch and pitchEnv targets times partial, mode, operator or metal ratios) is at or above 0.45 x sample rate (21.6 kHz at 48 kHz). Filter cutoffs are exempt. |
| `tick-length` | error | auto | patch | Ticks (families ui-click and blip) have an energy length (to -40 dB below peak) of 60 ms or less. |
| `tail-ceiling` | warn | auto | patch | The tail (to -60 dB below peak) stays within the family ceiling: ui-* 0.25 s, blip 0.15 s, coin/pickup/confirm/no 0.8 s, jump/land/hit/laser 0.8 s, powerup/powerdown 1.2 s, whoosh 1.5 s, alarm 1.5 s, explosion 3.5 s, anything else 2.0 s. |
| `sharpness-warn` | warn | auto | patch | Sharpness above 2.2 acum is reported unless the patch is tagged 'bright'. |
| `roughness-warn` | warn | auto | patch | Roughness above 0.6 asper is reported unless the patch is tagged 'gritty'. |
| `variation-on-repeating` | error | auto | patch | A patch tagged 'repeating' declares variation: at least 3 variants, or a pitch spread of at least 20 cents. |
| `loudness-target` | error | auto | patch | The delivered sound's max momentary loudness is within 1.5 LU of its target: the project's targetLoudness plus the family offset. |
| `reverb-preset-only` | error | auto | patch | Reverb comes only from the preset generated-impulse-response convolvers (small, room, hall, cave, space), never from a DelayNode feedback network. The patch schema enforces this. |
| `silent-not-quiet` | warn | judgement | patch | A gated bed (meta.intent 'bed') stops when its cause stops; it does not duck to a quiet hum. A tool that hums while doing nothing teaches the player to ignore it. |
| `synthesis-choice` | warn | judgement | patch | The synthesis method fits the material: modal for struck objects (wood, metal, glass, bells struck), grains for shakers, rain, debris and crackle, additive for bells and sustained realism, 808 metal for cymbals and robots, oscillators and FM for abstract UI and retro tones. |
| `one-no` | error | auto | kit | A kit has exactly one sound in family 'no', and every refusal in the game uses it, so the player learns it once. More than one is an error; none is a warning. |
| `priority-levels` | error | auto | kit | A kit uses at most 5 distinct priority levels. |
| `family-consistency` | warn | auto | kit | Within one family, spectral centroids span at most one octave, so the family reads as one class of sound. |
| `key-consistency` | warn | auto | kit | Every pitched kit member (pitch strength at least 0.7) has a measured pitch within 50 cents of a pitch in the project scale. |
| `masking-risk` | warn | auto | kit | Two kit members whose dominant octave band is the same and whose centroids are within a third of an octave (ratio below 2^(1/3)) are reported as a masking risk. |
| `one-meaning-per-sound` | warn | judgement | kit | If the player hears it, something happened: every kit sound is caused by one world event and means one thing. No sound plays as texture, and no two events share a sound unless they share a meaning. |

### Music rules

| Rule | Severity | Check | Applies to | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `song-true-peak` | error | auto | song | The delivered song's true peak is at or below -1 dBTP. |
| `song-no-clipping` | error | auto | song | The delivered song has no clipped samples. |
| `song-loudness-target` | warn | auto | song | The delivered song sits within 2 LU of project.musicLoudness (integrated). A song more than 2 LU under is peak-limited: its transients cap the level. |
| `song-loudness-range` | warn | auto | song | Loudness range (EBU Tech 3342) is at most 20 LU, and at least 3 LU for songs longer than a minute. |
| `song-loop-seam` | warn | auto | song | A loop song's level steps no more than 3 dB across the loop point (median 100 ms block level over the last 1.5 s against the first 1.5 s). |
| `song-loop-boundary-step` | warn | auto | song | A loop song's last sample meets its first within 24 dB of the file's typical sample-to-sample step (a clean seam is about 0 to 10 dB; a tick is 30 dB or more). A loop that starts on a transient by design may exceed it. |
| `song-loop-length` | warn | auto | song | A loop song lasts at least 60 s when tagged exploration, ambient or level, and at least 20 s otherwise. |
| `song-low-end` | warn | auto | song | Energy below 120 Hz is at most 40% of the song's spectrum, and at least 2% (the minimum does not apply to songs tagged ambience). |
| `song-register` | warn | auto | song | Pitched notes stay between E1 (41 Hz) and C8 (4186 Hz). |
| `song-written-pitch` | warn | auto | song | A pitched instrument is written within an octave of its own root; farther, it is retuned so far that it no longer sounds as built. |
| `song-unused` | warn | auto | song | Every track and pattern is played somewhere in the form. |
| `song-register-bands` | warn | judgement | song | Parts that play together sit in different registers or leave each other rhythmic gaps; fix a masking clash in the arrangement (voicing, octave, rhythm) before the mix. |
| `song-fatigue` | warn | judgement | song | Music heard for a long time (exploration, menus) keeps melody understated, varies its sections, and leaves space: rests, thinned sections, slow fades in rather than an abrupt start. |
| `song-adaptive-states` | warn | judgement | song | Every adaptive state is music on its own: the calm state may be all the player hears for minutes, so render and listen to each state's layers alone, not only the full mix. |
